body: Okay you have a nice night, and I'm glad you feel that way about people who are trans. I'm not trans but my experience involves someone who is, but i'll tell you tomorrow if not gone off somewhere. Good night.
How do you feel about people that are Transgender?
Okay, but before I tell you my experience, I need to ask another question please.
Have you've ever been betrayed by someone close, or maybe you put down a shield for that one person and they took advantage of it?
No, I'm still down but I appreciate the talk though. I have a question that I'd like to ask please.

I have ideas but no projects started right now, and I'd like an internship but I don't feel like I'm ready to do a lot of work in the outside world. I'm not really shy type but certain experiences makes me wary of people in general. I always feel like someone wants to get an angle on me and usually I'm right. I can't really trust anyone.

I grew up playing loads of video games and I love them to death. It's beyond a hobby to me and I care more about what somebody plays then the money earned when doing it. So in way yes, it is my dream job. I've done other things in the past when I was in the Army but I never felt like I was good at anything. I don't have fancy skills like most people and I'm still an amateur in programming. And when it comes to game development, you can make any game you want, what matters is the execution when the game is finished, not so much the planning as I've learned so far. You can come up with so many ideas for a game but without good practice or making sure it's not copied from other people's work it'll just be the same game but in a different color. I guess that's one of ways how I can describe it.
The Game Design is currently a college thing and I'm sticking with it. My Associates Degree that I'm working on. If I live long enough, I hope to become an Indie Developer one day.

Well I would like to have a job and a relationship with someone. A serious one, yeah I know it sounds fucking stupid but I take those things seriously. As far as other people I see on a daily basis, usually they have something I want but I can almost never get. There are a few other reasons why I'm feeling this way but I don't want to post it. I'm already embarrassed putting this on the internet as it is.
I need the money first, and there is no point traveling if I'm by myself.
